leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Node.js script to read and parse raw usage data from a JSON file
Implement a function to aggregate usage data by customer ID and service type
Configure a data transformation pipeline to calculate total usage and cost per customer
Initialize and manipulate a data structure to store aggregated billing results
Integrate file system operations to write the aggregated results to a new JSON file
Apply error handling to manage missing data or file read/write failures
Control the execution flow of the pipeline to process data sequentially
